authorization: User accepted selective K2 box roughening experiment: 'ok làm đi'.
purpose: Test whether K2 noise on measured bounding-box dimensions harms next-frame prediction while motion-state roughening helps.

design.controls: R70 K1K2 box scale 1 must match MOT files byte-for-byte

analysis.aggregation: TrackEval COMBINED per seed then arithmetic seed mean
analysis.uncertainty: paired video bootstrap 5000 draws, fixed seed 0; compare box 0.5 and 0 against box 1
analysis.diagnostics: ancestor diversity from last_resample_idx; prediction error conditional on prior output and current GT, by gap
analysis.scope: dev evidence only; no new test dataset

gates: Targeted synthetic and YAML tests pass
Baseline box1 outputs equal R70 bytes
Full 9x12 tracking and raw-field evaluation validated
